label: GO step after an unrewarded trial (sparse; strongest early in episode and after a fixation-break penalty)
explanation: Never active at D1 and essentially never after a rewarded trial. 91% of activation mass is on GO steps whose previous trial was unrewarded, and almost all of the top activations fall there. It fires on only ~6% of those steps though, so precision is very low. Rates are much higher early in the episode (trials 0-9, about 4x; ep_trial 1, 17x) and when the agent broke fixation at D1 and saw the -1 penalty at GO (in_rew=-1, 83% rate, 18% of mass). It is mildly enriched when the upcoming choice or argmax is a2 and the previous choice was a2. The small D2 component (9% of mass, weak) is a1 leading to S2 (a rare transition). Refinements (two unrewarded trials in a row, prev_action==2, early-episode, value band) raise precision to at most ~0.3 and lose a lot of mass. Uses observed variables only.
